name: stamp
label: The verdict that slams: 1 to 3 words, alone or layered over another comp

variant.label: ink = rubber stamp, sticker = a label slapped on, tape = a band across the zone

sub.label: Optional second line, at most 4 words (ink and sticker)

x.label: Layered: centre x in frame px (blank = zone centre)

y.label: Layered: centre y in frame px (blank = zone centre)

out.label: cut = hold to the end, edge = leave
